blurb: Guests can join open-party or private charter fishing trips on various vessels equipped with modern fishing gear and amenities. Trips range from half-day to multi-day excursions targeting species like yellowtail, bass, tuna, and more. The center offers tackle rental, fishing licenses, and onboard assistance from experienced crew.
extraNote: No refunds or reschedules within 24 hours of trip; refunds subject to 10% fee · Private charter deposits are non-refundable · Captain may cancel trips due to rough weather for safety · Gratuity not included; tipping appreciated onboard · Check in at the office at 315 Harbor Dr. S, Oceanside, CA 92054, 45 minutes prior to departure.
